header.title: How to Remove Mildew from the Interior of a Dishwasher
header.description: This guide provides a simple method for removing mildew from the interior of your dishwasher using common household ingredients. Follow these steps to clean and refresh your dishwasher, ensuring optimal performance.

steps.description: Remove dishwasher racks and silverware tray, clean them, and set them aside to dry.
actions: Remove the racks from the dishwasher
Remove the silverware tray from the dishwasher
Access the corners and crevices of the dishwasher
Wash the racks with hot water
Wash the silverware tray with hot water
Put the racks aside to dry
Put the silverware tray aside to dry

steps.description: Clean the inside of the dishwasher using a vinegar and water solution.
actions: Add ½ cup of white vinegar to 2 cups of hot water in a large bowl.
Mix the vinegar and water thoroughly.
Apply the mixture inside the dishwasher using a sponge.
Scrub the inside of the dishwasher thoroughly.
If needed, use an old toothbrush to clean mildew.

steps.description: This step involves running the dishwasher with vinegar and baking soda to remove mildew and mold.
actions: Add white vinegar to a small dishwasher-safe bowl
Place the bowl on the top rack
Start the dishwasher with the highest level of heating available
Put 1 cup of baking soda at the bottom of the dishwasher floor
Run the dishwasher with the highest level of heating a second time
